from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess

B=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
P=Path('<runtime-checkout>')
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.file_digest(p.open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()
source=B/'audit_original_q8192_rejected_rows_r1.cpp'
prior_path=B/'original-q8192-projection-host-sample-r1/comparison.json'
prior=read(prior_path)
d=B/'original-q8192-rejected-rows-host-r1'
d.mkdir()
todo=[P/'native/providers/moe_accumulator/q1_moe_hawkeye_bf16_accumulator.h',
      P/'native/providers/moe_accumulator/sm121_narrow_f32_carry.h'];seen=set()
while todo:
    p=todo.pop().resolve()
    if p in seen:continue
    assert p.is_relative_to(P);seen.add(p)
    for inc in re.findall(r'^\s*#include "([^"\n]+)"',p.read_text(),re.M):todo.append((p.parent/inc).resolve())
inputs={str(p.relative_to(P)):sha(p) for p in sorted(seen)}
command=['c++','-std=c++17','-O2','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror','-fsanitize=address,undefined',
         '-fno-sanitize-recover=all','-I',str(P),str(source),'-o',str(d/'audit')]
compiled=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=45)
record=dict(source_sha256=sha(source),source_commit=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=P,text=True,timeout=10).strip(),
    quoted_include_bindings=inputs,quoted_includes_are_compiler_dependency_list=False,
    prior_sample_sha256=sha(prior_path),reference=prior['reference'],
    compile_command=command,compile_returncode=compiled.returncode,compile_stdout=compiled.stdout,compile_stderr=compiled.stderr,
    compile_timeout_seconds=45,run_timeout_seconds=90,runs=[],tensors=prior['tensors'],
    host_arithmetic_only=True,gpu_executed=False,inference_acceptance=False,performance_acceptance=False)
out=d/'comparison.json'
try:
    compiled.check_returncode()
    for mode in ('qkv','out'):
        tensors=prior['tensors'][mode]
        for tensor in tensors:
            assert (B/tensor['file']).stat().st_size==tensor['bytes'] and sha(B/tensor['file'])==tensor['sha256']
        cmd=[str(d/'audit'),mode,*[str(B/t['file']) for t in tensors]]
        r=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=90)
        entry=dict(command=cmd,returncode=r.returncode,stdout=r.stdout,stderr=r.stderr)
        record['runs'].append(entry);r.check_returncode()
        result=json.loads(r.stdout);entry['result']=result
        assert result['gb10_bf16_mismatches']==0 and result['repeated_rows']==0
        assert len(result['rejected_input_rows'])==(1 if mode=='out' else 0)
        assert len(result['rejected_weight_rows'])==(112 if mode=='qkv' else 0)
        assert result['verified_dots']==(2048 if mode=='out' else 1792)
finally:
    with out.open('x') as f:json.dump(record,f,indent=2,allow_nan=False);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(file=str(out.relative_to(B)),sha256=sha(out),results=[r['result'] for r in record['runs']])),flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess

B=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
P=Path('<runtime-checkout>')
sha=lambda p:hashlib.file_digest(p.open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()
original=P/'native/providers/moe_accumulator/sm121_partial_wave_projection.h'
source=B/'partial_wave_projection_host_coord_r1.cpp'
text=original.read_text()
extracted=text[text.index('__device__ __forceinline__ Row broadcast'):text.index('template<bool Trace>\n__global__ void unsupported')]
d=B/'partial-wave-projection-host-coordinates-r1';d.mkdir()
inc=d/'extracted_replay.inc';inc.write_text(extracted)
todo=[P/'native/providers/moe_accumulator/sm121_partial_matrix_group.h'];seen=set()
while todo:
 p=todo.pop().resolve()
 if p in seen:continue
 assert p.is_relative_to(P);seen.add(p)
 for name in re.findall(r'^\s*#include "([^"\n]+)"',p.read_text(),re.M):todo.append((p.parent/name).resolve())
command=['c++','-std=c++20','-O1','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror','-Wno-psabi','-Wno-unknown-pragmas',
 '-fsanitize=address,undefined','-fno-sanitize-recover=all','-I',str(P),'-I',str(d),str(source),'-o',str(d/'check')]
r=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=45)
record=dict(source_commit=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=P,text=True,timeout=10).strip(),
 original_kernel=str(original.relative_to(P)),original_kernel_sha256=sha(original),extracted_replay_sha256=sha(inc),
 source_sha256=sha(source),quoted_include_bindings={str(p.relative_to(P)):sha(p) for p in sorted(seen)},
 compile_command=command,compile_returncode=r.returncode,compile_stdout=r.stdout,compile_stderr=r.stderr,
 compile_timeout_seconds=45,execution_timeout_seconds=180,
 host_execution_model_only=True,physical_wmma_semantics_verified=False,gpu_executed=False,inference_acceptance=False,performance_acceptance=False)
try:
 if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError('Compile failed: '+r.stderr[-4000:])
 cmd=[str(d/'check')]
 try:
  run=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180)
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
  record.update(command=cmd,returncode=None,timeout=True,stdout=str(error.stdout),stderr=str(error.stderr));raise
 record.update(command=cmd,returncode=run.returncode,stdout=run.stdout,stderr=run.stderr)
 if run.returncode:raise RuntimeError('Coordinate model failed: '+run.stderr[-4000:])
 result=json.loads(run.stdout);record['result']=result
 assert result['cases']==72 and result['raw_bit_mismatches']==0 and result['redzones_pass'] and result['immutable_inputs']
finally:
 out=d/'comparison.json'
 with out.open('x')as f:json.dump(record,f,indent=2,allow_nan=False);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(file=str(out.relative_to(B)),sha256=sha(out),result=result)),flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess

B=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sha=lambda p:hashlib.file_digest(p.open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text())
control=B/'partial-wave-projection-host-coordinates-r1'
proof=read(control/'comparison.json')
assert proof['returncode']==0 and proof['result']['cases']==72
text=(control/'extracted_replay.inc').read_text()
mutations=[('wrong_broadcast_row','broadcast(b,item*2u+lane/16u)','broadcast(b,(item*2u+lane/16u)^1u)'),
           ('wrong_output_cell','output[size_t(token)*rows+first_row+item*2u+lane/16u]','output[size_t(token)*rows+first_row+item*2u+lane/16u+1u]')]
root=B/'partial-wave-projection-host-coordinates-faults-r1';root.mkdir()
records=[]
for name,before,after in mutations:
 assert text.count(before)==1
 d=root/name;d.mkdir();inc=d/'extracted_replay.inc';inc.write_text(text.replace(before,after))
 cmd=[str(d) if part==str(control) else str(d/'check') if part==str(control/'check') else part for part in proof['compile_command']]
 c=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=45)
 item=dict(name=name,mutation=dict(before=before,after=after),mutated_replay_sha256=sha(inc),compile_command=cmd,
           compile_returncode=c.returncode,compile_stdout=c.stdout,compile_stderr=c.stderr)
 records.append(item)
 if c.returncode:raise RuntimeError(c.stderr[-2500:])
 r=subprocess.run([str(d/'check')],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
 item.update(command=r.args,returncode=r.returncode,stdout=r.stdout,stderr=r.stderr)
 assert r.returncode!=0 and ('ordered carry differs' in r.stderr or 'output differs' in r.stderr or 'inactive output changed' in r.stderr or 'redzone changed' in r.stderr),item
record=dict(positive_control_sha256=sha(control/'comparison.json'),faults=records,
            declared_model_miswiring_rejected=True,gpu_executed=False,physical_wmma_semantics_verified=False)
out=root/'comparison.json'
with out.open('x')as f:json.dump(record,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(file=str(out.relative_to(B)),sha256=sha(out),rejected=[dict(name=x['name'],returncode=x['returncode'],stderr=x['stderr']) for x in records])),flush=True)
